original: yadapi candrikāyām -- aikādhikaraṇyamatadvaye’pi vākyadvayamapyudāharaṇamiti kalpanam, tathā yathā hyagrisūktasthavākye prakaraṇānugṛhītaśrutyā pūrvapakṣastathā chāndogye’pi gāyatrī iti sarvam ityupakramāt saiṣā catuṣpadā ṣaḍvidhā gāyatrī iti copasaṃhārāttasya gāyatrīprakaraṇatvena tadanugṛhītajyotiḥ -- śrutyā pūrvapakṣa iti
analyzed: yat api candrikāyām aikādhikaraṇya mata dvaye pi vākya dvayam api udāharaṇam iti kalpanam tathā yathā hi agri sūkta stha vākye prakaraṇa anugṛhīta śrutyā pūrvapakṣaḥ tathā chāndogye pi gāyatrī iti sarvam iti upakramāt sā eṣā catuṣpadā ṣaḍvidhā gāyatrī iti ca upasaṃhārāt tasya gāyatrī prakaraṇa tvena tad anugṛhīta jyotiḥ śrutyā pūrvapakṣaḥ iti

original: pūrvapakṣayuktisādhāraṇyāttathāgrisūkte viratiśayavaibhavalakṣaṇacaraṇena siddhāntavacchāndogye’pi etāmeva nātiśīyante iti niratiśayavaibhavarūpeṇa caraṇena siddhānta iti siddhāntayuktisādhāraṇyāccaikādhiraṇatā|
analyzed: pūrvapakṣa yukti sādhāraṇyāt tathā agri sūkte virati śaya vaibhava lakṣaṇa caraṇena siddhānta vat chāndogye pi etām eva na atiśīyante iti niratiśaya vaibhava rūpeṇa caraṇena siddhāntaḥ iti siddhānta yukti sādhāraṇyāt ca ekādhiraṇatā

original: yathāghārāgrihotrādyādhikaraṇeṣu ādhāramāghārayati agrihotraṃ juhoti ityudāharaṇabhede’pi dravyadevatālakṣaṇayāgarūpābhāvānna yāgāvidhitvamiti pūrvapakṣayuktisādhāraṇyānmantravarṇādinā devatādilābhānna rūpādyabhāva iti siddhāntayuktisādhāraṇyāccaikādhikaraṇatā tadvat iti vākyadvayodāharaṇatvopapādanaṃ ca| tadapi na sat|
analyzed: yathā āghāra agrihotra ādya adhikaraṇeṣu ādhāram āghārayati agrihotram juhoti iti udāharaṇa bhede pi dravya devatā lakṣaṇa yāga rūpa abhāvāt na yāga avidhi tvam iti pūrvapakṣa yukti sādhāraṇyāt mantra varṇa ādinā devatā ādi lābhāt na rūpa ādi abhāvaḥ iti siddhānta yukti sādhāraṇyāt ca eka adhikaraṇa tā tadvat iti vākya dvaya udāharaṇa tva upapādanam ca tat api na sat

original: chāndogyasthajyotiṣo vicaraṇābhidhānābhāvena pūrvapakṣasiddhāntayuktisādhāraṇyasyādikaraṇaikye’pi vākyadvayodāharaṇatāyāṃ sādhakatvenopanyastasyāsiddheḥ|
analyzed: chāndogya stha jyotiṣaḥ vicaraṇa abhidhāna abhāvena pūrvapakṣa siddhānta yukti sādhāraṇyasya ādikaraṇa aikye pi vākya dvaya udāharaṇatāyām sādhaka tvena upanyastasya asiddheḥ

original: yadapi candrikāyām -- agrisūkta iva etāmeva nātiśīyante iti niratiśayavaibhavarūpaṃ chāndogye’pyasyaiva vicaraṇābhidhānamastītyuktam| tadapi na|
analyzed: yat api candrikāyām agri sūkte iva etām eva na atiśīyante iti niratiśaya vaibhava rūpam chāndogye pi asya eva vicaraṇa abhidhānam asti iti uktam tat api na

original: vi me karṇā patayato vi cakṣuḥ ityāderagrisūktoktasya karṇāderviruddhapatanarūpajyotiratikramaṇarūpavicaraṇasya etāmeva nātiśīyante iti cchādogyoktagāyatryanātikramaṇarūpasya vicaraṇasya parasparaṃ bhinnasvalarūpasyekaśabdenābhidhānāyogāt| tābhyāṃ gamyamānaniratiśayavaibhavaparatvaṃ tu nābhidhānarūpaṃ sambhavatyāṃ gatau kliṣṭaṃ kalpayituṃ yuktam|
analyzed: vi me karṇā patayataḥ vi cakṣuḥ ityādeḥ agri sūkta uktasya karṇa ādeḥ viruddha patana rūpa jyotiḥ atikramaṇa rūpa vicaraṇasya etām eva na atiśīyante iti chādogya ukta gāyatrī an atikramaṇa rūpasya vicaraṇasya parasparam bhinna svala rūpasya ika śabdena abhidhāna ayogāt tābhyām gamyamāna niratiśaya vaibhava paratvam tu na abhidhāna rūpam sambhavatyām gatau kliṣṭam kalpayitum yuktam

original: kiṃ ca yadyubhayorvākyayoratra viṣayatā tadā chandobhidhānāt iti vat agnyabhidhānāt iti vaktavye tadabhidhānopekṣāyāṃ bījābhāvaḥ| chandaḥ śabdo’grerapyupalakṣakaḥ iti candrikoktaṃ tu na sat| upadeśabhedabhūtādavyapadeśayostadāpyagate |
analyzed: kim ca yadi ubhayoḥ vākyayoḥ atra viṣaya tā tadā chandaḥ abhidhānāt iti vat agni abhidhānāt iti vaktavye tad abhidhāna upekṣāyām bīja abhāvaḥ chandaḥ śabda ugreḥ api upalakṣakaḥ iti candrikā uktam tu na sat upadeśa bheda bhūtāt a vyapadeśayoḥ tadā api agate

original: upadeśabhedāditi pūrvapakṣayuktirbhūtādipādetisiddhāntayuktiścacchāndogyavākyamātrāsādhāraṇī iti cadrikoktaṃ tu chandrobhidhānāt iti sūtre tathaiva vaktuṃ śakyatayā tatropalakṣaṇatvāṅgīkārasya niṣphalatvāpattyānupādeyameva|
analyzed: upadeśa bhedāt iti pūrvapakṣa yuktiḥ bhūta ādi pāda iti siddhānta yuktiḥ ca chāndogya vākya mātra asādhāraṇī iti cadrikā uktam tu chandraḥ abhidhānāt iti sūtre tathā eva vaktum śakya tayā tatra upalakṣaṇa tva aṅgīkārasya niṣphala tva āpattyā anupādeyam eva

original: āghārāgrihotrādhikaraṇadṛṣṭānto’pyayukta eva| tadadhikaraṇe -- agrihotraṃ juhoti āghāramaghārayati ityādivākyaṃ na karmavidhāyakam| tatra dravyadevatayoraśrutatvāddravyadevatālakṣaṇayāgarūpasyābhāvāt|
analyzed: āghāra agrihotra adhikaraṇa dṛṣṭāntaḥ upi ayuktaḥ eva tad adhikaraṇe agrihotram juhoti āghāram aghārayati ityādi vākyam na karma vidhāyakam tatra dravya devatayoḥ aśruta tvāt dravya devatā lakṣaṇa yāga rūpasya abhāvāt

original: kintvagrihotravākyaṃ payasā juhoti dadhnā juhoti ityādivākyavihitasya karmasamudāyasya, āghāravākyam ṛjumāghārayati ūrdhvamāghārayati ityādi vākyavihitakarmasamudāyasyānuvāda iti pūrvapakṣe -- dadhyādivākyena na dadhyādiguṇamātravidhānaṃ sambhavati| tvanmate’grihotra vākyasya karmavidhāyakatvābhāvena guṇinaḥ kasyācidasiddheḥ|
analyzed: kintu agrihotra vākyam payasā juhoti dadhnā juhoti ityādi vākya vihitasya karma samudāyasya āghāra vākyam ṛjum āghārayati ūrdhvam āghārayati ityādi vākya vihita karma samudāyasya anuvādaḥ iti pūrvapakṣe dadhi ādi vākyena na dadhi ādi guṇa mātra vidhānam sambhavati tvad mate grihotra vākyasya karma vidhāyaka tva abhāvena guṇinaḥ kasyācid asiddheḥ

original: nāpi dadhyādiguṇaviśiṣṭakarmavidhānaṃ sambhavati| vidhigauravāpatte | tasmādagrihotrādivākyameva karmavidhāyakam| tatra dadhyādivākyairdravyalābhaḥ| devatā ca homakaraṇamantravarṇāt iti siddhānte cobhayagocaragrāhakasya sādhāraṇasyeva prakṛte pūrvapakṣāsiddhāntayuktisādhāraṇasyāsiddheruktatvāt|
analyzed: nā api dadhi ādi guṇa viśiṣṭa karma vidhānam sambhavati vidhi gaurava āpatte tasmāt agrihotra ādi vākyam eva karma vidhāyakam tatra dadhi ādi vākyaiḥ dravya lābhaḥ devatā ca homa karaṇa mantra varṇāt iti siddhānte ca ubhaya gocara grāhakasya sādhāraṇasya iva prakṛte pūrvapakṣa asiddhānta yukti sādhāraṇasya asiddheḥ ukta tvāt

original: yadapi candrikāyām -- upadeśabhedāt iti pūrvapakṣayuktiḥ bhūtādipāde iti siddhāntayuktiśca cchāndogyavākyamātrāsādhāraṇītyatrārthavādanaye bhaṭṭamata eko vicāro’rthavādamantrādisādhāraṇaḥ| anyastvarthavādamātrāsādhāraṇa iti dviparvavicāradṛṣṭāntakathanam| tadapi na|
analyzed: yat api candrikāyām upadeśa bhedāt iti pūrvapakṣa yuktiḥ bhūta ādi pāde iti siddhānta yuktiḥ ca chāndogya vākya mātrā sādhāraṇī iti atra arthavāda naye bhaṭṭa mate ekaḥ vicāra ūrthavāda mantra ādi sādhāraṇaḥ anyaḥ tu arthavāda mātrā sādhāraṇaḥ iti dvi parva vicāra dṛṣṭānta kathanam tat api na

original: arthavādanaye hi vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā devatā ityarthavādagatāḥ śabdāstathā uru prathasva iti mantragatāśca śabdāḥ vāyavyaṃ śvetamālabheta bhūtikāmaḥ iti vidhigatavāyavyādiśabdānāṃ tathā puroḍāyāṃ prathayati iti vidhigataśabdānāṃ ca nairapekṣyeṇaiva bhūtārthamanvācakṣate |
analyzed: arthavāda naye hi vāyuḥ vai kṣepiṣṭhāḥ devatā iti arthavāda gatāḥ śabdāḥ tathā uru prathasva iti mantra gatāḥ ca śabdāḥ vāyavyam śvetam ālabheta bhūti kāmaḥ iti vidhi gata vāyavya ādi śabdānām tathā puroḍāyām prathayati iti vidhi gata śabdānām ca nairapekṣyeṇa eva bhūta artham anvācakṣate

original: vidhivākyagatavāyavyādiśabdā arthavādagataśabdanairapekṣyeṇaiva viśiṣṭamarthaṃ vidadhatīti mantrārthavādebhyo bhāratarāmāyaṇādivatkaścidvṛttāntaḥ pratīyate, na tvanuṣṭheyaṃ kiñcidityekavākyatvābhāvānnārthavādamantrāṇāṃ dharmai prāmāṇyamiti pūrvapakṣe -- padaikavākyatvābhāve’pi vidhivākyasya puruṣaṃ prerayituṃ
analyzed: vidhi vākya gata vāyavya ādi śabdāḥ arthavāda gata śabda nairapekṣyeṇa eva viśiṣṭam artham vidadhati iti mantra arthavādebhyaḥ bhārata rāmāyaṇa ādi vat kaścid vṛttāntaḥ pratīyate na tu anuṣṭheyam kiñcid iti ekavākya tva abhāvāt na arthavāda mantrāṇām dharmaiḥ prāmāṇyam iti pūrvapakṣe pada ekavākya tva abhāve pi vidhi vākyasya puruṣam prerayitum

original: vidheyārthaprāśastyadevatāprakāśādyapekṣatvādarthavādamantrāṇāṃ ca phalavadarthāvabodhaparyavasitādhyayanavidhiparigṛhītatvena pūruṣārthāpekṣatvātprāśastyaṃ lakṣaṇayā samarpayadyataḥ kṣipragāmī(mi) svabhāvatayā śīghraphalaprado vāyurasya parśordevatā tataḥ praśastamimaṃ vāyavyaṃ paśumālabhetoti vākyayoranvayādarthavādānāṃ vidhivākyekavākyatayā
analyzed: vidheya artha prāśastya devatā prakāśa ādi apekṣa tvāt arthavāda mantrāṇām ca phalavat artha avabodha paryavasita adhyayana vidhi parigṛhīta tvena pūruṣa artha apekṣa tvāt prāśastyam lakṣaṇayā samarpayat yatas svabhāvatayā śīghra phala pradaḥ vāyuḥ asya parśoḥ devatā tatas praśastam imam vāyavyam paśum ālabheta iti vākyayoḥ anvayāt arthavādānām vidhi vākya ekavākyatayā

original: dharme prāmāṇyam| evaṃ mantrāṇāmapi vidhyaikavākyatayaiva prāmāṇyamityeko vicāro mantrārthavādasādhāraṇaḥ| yato vāyuḥ kṣiprameva phalaprado’to vāyavyaṃ paśumālabhetatyevamarthavādoktaṃ hetumapekṣyaiva vidhiḥ puruṣaṃ niyuṅkte| tataḥ sāpekṣatvādvirvarna prāmāṇyamanapekṣyatvarūpamiti pūrvapakṣe -- sāpekṣatvaṃ hi pramāṇantarādigatārthabodhakatvam|
analyzed: dharme prāmāṇyam evam mantrāṇām api vidhi a eka vākya tayā eva prāmāṇyam iti ekaḥ vicāraḥ mantra arthavāda sādhāraṇaḥ yatas vāyuḥ kṣipram eva phala pradotaḥ vāyavyam paśum ālabheta iti evam arthavāda uktam hetum apekṣya eva vidhiḥ puruṣam niyuṅkte tatas sāpekṣa tvāt prāmāṇyam anapekṣya tva rūpam iti pūrvapakṣe sāpekṣa tvam hi pramāṇa antara ādi gata artha bodhaka tvam

original: arthavāde vimataṃ karmānuṣṭheyaṃ phalavadadevatopotatvādrājasevāvat ityanumānaṃ yadi vivākṣitaṃ syāttadā virdharnānāntarasāpekṣatvalakṣaṇamapramāṇyaṃ syāt| na tvevamasti| kintu phalapadadevatātīṣakatvopanyāsena karmaprāśastyamuvalakṣyate| tathā yati praśastaṃ karmānuṣṭheyamityasminnarye sārvavādavidheḥ| paryavasānādekavākyatā labhyata iti kutaḥ|
analyzed: arthavāde vimatam karma anuṣṭheyam phalavat adevatā upota tvāt rāja sevā vat iti anumānam yadi syāt tadā apramāṇyam syāt na tu evam asti kintu phala pada devatā atīṣaka tva upanyāsena karma prāśastyam uvalakṣyate tathā yati praśastam karma anuṣṭheyam iti asmin arye sārvavāda vidheḥ paryavasānāt ekavākya tā labhyate iti kutas

original: pramāṇāntarasāpekṣatvamiti vidhiḥ pramāṇameveti siddhānta ityanyo vicāro’rthavādamātrasādhāraṇaḥ| tatra dvitīyavicāreṇa kṛtasya mānāntarānapekṣatvarūpaprāmāṇyaprakāraviśeṣasthāpanasya prathamavicārakṛtasāmānyena prāmāṇyasiddhyadhīnasiddhikatvādvicāradvayasya parasparapekṣatvavadiha vicāradvayasya parasparāpekṣatvābhāvāt, tadvadiha vicāradvayasya
analyzed: pramāṇa antara sāpekṣa tvam iti vidhiḥ pramāṇam eva iti siddhāntaḥ iti anyaḥ vicāra ūrthavāda mātra sādhāraṇaḥ tatra dvitīya vicāreṇa kṛtasya māna antara anapekṣa tva rūpa prāmāṇya prakāra viśeṣa sthāpanasya prathama vicāra kṛta sāmānyena prāmāṇya siddhi adhīna siddhika tvāt vicāra dvayasya paraspara pekṣa tva vat iha vicāra dvayasya paraspara apekṣa tva abhāvāt tadvat iha vicāra dvayasya

original: sāmānyaviśeṣarūpahetudvayābhāvācca vaiṣamyasya tadvidāṃ spaṣṭatvāt|
analyzed: sāmānya viśeṣa rūpa hetu dvaya abhāvāt ca vaiṣamyasya tad vidām spaṣṭa tvāt

original: yadapyānandatīrthīyānāṃ prathamādhikaraṇaśarīram -- jyotiridamāgrirviṣṇurveti sandehaḥ| asya sūktasyāgrisūktatvāttadgatajyotiḥ śabdo’griparaḥ| na ca hṛdaya āhitaṃ yat iti guhānihitatvaliṅgena bādhaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ| prakaraṇasanāthāyāḥ śruterliṅgena durbalena bādhāyogāt| na ca niravakāśatvaṃ śruteriva liṅgasyāpi|
analyzed: yat api ānandatīrthīyānām prathama adhikaraṇa śarīram jyotiḥ idam āgriḥ viṣṇuḥ vā iti sandehaḥ asya sūktasya agri sūkta tvāt tad gata jyotiḥ śabda ugri paraḥ na ca hṛdaye āhitam yat iti guhā nihita tva liṅgena bādhaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ prakaraṇa sanāthāyāḥ śruteḥ liṅgena durbalena bādhā yogāt na ca niravakāśa tvam śruteḥ iva liṅgasya api

original: jāṭhare jātavedasi liṅgasya sāvakāśatvāt| ataḥ sāvakāśaliṅgātparabalābhyāṃ prakaraṇaśrutibhyāmuktajyotiṣo yuktamagritvamiti pūrvapakṣe -- niravakāśena karṇādividuratvena prakararaṇabādhācchruterviṣṇāveva mahāyogavidarvadvadrūḍhibhyāmupapatterviṣṇurevedaṃ jyotiriti siddhāntaḥ| spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ candrikādau tadīyagranthe|
analyzed: jāṭhare jātavedasi liṅgasya sāvakāśa tvāt atas sāvakāśa liṅgāt para balābhyām prakaraṇa śrutibhyām ukta jyotiṣaḥ yuktam agri tvam iti pūrvapakṣe niravakāśena karṇa ādi vidura tvena prakararaṇa bādhāt śruteḥ viṣṇau eva mahā yoga vidarvat vat rūḍhibhyām upapatteḥ viṣṇuḥ eva idam jyotiḥ iti siddhāntaḥ spaṣṭam ca idam candrikā ādau tadīya granthe

original: tatredaṃ cintyam -- niravakāśaliṅgena śrutibādhasya pūrvādhikaraṇadvayasiddhatvena punarihānyaparatvaśaṅkānutthānāt| prakāraṇasya liṅgāddurbalatvena na tatsahāyenoktaśaṅkotthānam| niravakāśatayā prabalena liṅgena prakaraṇabādhakasya kaimutyanyāyasiddhatvāt| etena tvamagre ityagriśabdasannidhānādagriparatvaśaṅketi candrikoktakalpanaṃ nirastam|
analyzed: tatra idam cintyam niravakāśa liṅgena śruti bādhasya pūrva adhikaraṇa dvaya siddhatvena punar iha anya paratva śaṅkā anutthānāt prakāraṇasya liṅgāt durbala tvena na tad sahāyena ukta śaṅkā utthānam niravakāśa tayā prabalena liṅgena prakaraṇa bādhakasya kaimutya nyāya siddhatvāt etena tvam agre iti agri śabda sannidhānāt agri paratva śaṅkā iti candrikā ukta kalpanam nirastam

original: sannidhānasya prakaraṇādapi durbalatvena tadvādhasya daṇhāpūpikānyāyasiddhatvāt| kiñca jyotiḥ śabdāgriśabdayordevatāparatve’ntaradhikaraṇanyāyela , bhūtaparatva ākāśādikaraṇanyāyena gatārthatvaṃ durvāram| na ca prakaraṇānugrahādadhikā śaṅketi yaktam| śruterviṣaṇuparatve prakaraṇasyāpi viṣṇuparatvasambhavenānyaparatvāyogāt|
analyzed: sannidhānasya prakaraṇāt api durbala tvena tad vādhasya daṇhāpūpikā nyāya siddha tvāt kiñca jyotiḥ śabda agri śabdayoḥ bhūta paratve ākāśa ādi karaṇa nyāyena gatārtha tvam durvāram na ca prakaraṇa anugrahāt adhikā śaṅkā iti yaktam śruteḥ viṣaṇu paratve prakaraṇasya api viṣṇu paratva sambhavena anya paratva ayogāt

original: vaidārthanirṇāyakanyāyānāmapi vedamūlakatve’navasthāpattyā śrutyādyamūlakatve’pi pratiṣṭhitatvasyā vaśyakatvācca| evaṃ ca noktanyāyena vilakṣaṇatvādirkāṇāmapratiṣṭhitatvasiddhiriti anumeyam iti śaṅkābhāgārthaḥ| sākṣātparamparayā vā śrutipratyakṣānusāriṇa eva tarkasya pratiṣṭhitatvam| tarkāpratiṣṭhitatvalakṣaṇastarko’pi śrutyanusāryeva|

original: anyathā bāhmoktatarkeṇa śrutyāprāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt| evaṃ vedatātparyanirṇāyako’pi tarkaḥ kvacitpratyakṣānugṛhītaḥ kvacicchratyanugṛhītaḥ kvacicca tadaviruddhanyāyāviriddho vā bhavatīti nāprayojaka iti tarkāṇāṃ pratiṣṭhitatve’pi durvārameveti evamapyanirmokṣaprasaṅgaḥ iti siddhāntabhāvārthaḥ|
analyzed: anyathā bāhma ukta tarkeṇa śrutyā aprāmāṇya prasaṅgāt evam veda tātparya nirṇāyakaḥ api tarkaḥ kvacid pratyakṣa anugṛhītaḥ kvacid śrati anugṛhītaḥ kvacid ca tad aviruddha nyāya aviriddhaḥ vā bhavati iti na aprayojakaḥ iti tarkāṇām pratiṣṭhita tve pi durvāram eva iti evam api anirmokṣa prasaṅgaḥ iti siddhānta bhāva arthaḥ

original: yadvā tarkāpratiṣṭhānāditi -- yadyasmādvilakṣaṇaṃ tattadupādānakaṃ netisāmānyavyāpreryattatpadārthadhaṭitatvena pakṣasapakṣasādhāraṇyenānugatīkartumaśakyatayā sādhyāsādhakatvādityarthaḥ| dṛṣṭānte hi ghaṭe survarṇavilakṣaṇatvaṃ suvarṇopādānakatvābhāve prayojakaṃ vaktavyam| na tadviyadāderbrahmopādānakatvābhāve sādhye hetū kartuṃ śakyate|
analyzed: yat vā tarka apratiṣṭhānāt iti yat yasmāt vilakṣaṇam tat tat upādānakam na iti sāmānya vyāpreḥ yat tat padārtha dhaṭita tvena pakṣa sapakṣa sādhāraṇyena anugatīkartum aśakyatayā sādhya asādhaka tvāt iti arthaḥ dṛṣṭānte hi ghaṭe survarṇa vilakṣaṇa tvam suvarṇa upādānaka tva abhāve prayojakam vaktavyam na tat viyat ādeḥ brahma upādānaka tva abhāve sādhye hetū kartum śakyate

analyzed: api tu brahma avilakṣaṇatvam tathā ca dṛṣṭanta dārṣṭāntikayoḥ sādhya tā avacchedaka hetutā avacchedakayoḥ aikya alābhaḥ tad alābhe pakṣa vṛtti hetau vyāpti graha asaṃbhavāt anumitiḥ asaṃbhāvitā eva śāstra ayonitva sūtre śruti siddhe sārvajñye saṃbhāvanā mātra prayojanāya yat yat vistara artham śāstram yasmāt puruṣa viśeṣāt saṃbhavati sa tatas pi adhikatara jñānavān iti

analyzed: sāmānya vyāpti upanyāse api svātantryeṇa kaṃcid api artham prati sādhaka tvena upanyāsa abhāvāt na asaṃgatiḥ nanu dṛṣṭānta dārṣṭāntikayoḥ sādhyā tā avacchedaka hetu tā avacchedakayoḥ aikya abhāvena pakṣa vṛtti hetoḥ vyāpti graha abhāve pi prakṛta hetu sajātīya hetau prakṛta sādhya sajātīya sādhya nirūpita vyāpti grahāt prakṛta hetoḥ ca pakṣa dharma tā grahāt prakṛta sādhya anumitiḥ svīkriyate

original: avidyādṛṣṭāntena viśeṣavyāptireva vā vivakṣitāstu| tatra ca noktadoṣa iti śaṅkate -- anyathānumeyamiti | prakṛtahetusajātīyahetau prakṛtasādhyasajītīyasādhyanirūpitavyāptyā viśevyāṣaptyā vānumeyamityarthaḥ| evamapi -- uktapakṣe’pi |

original: anirmokṣaprasaṅkāt(ṅgaḥ) -- aprayojakatvaparihākārtham tadvilakṣaṇatvaṃ brahmāvilakṣaṇatvaṃ vā tadupādānakatve brahmopādānakatve vā na syāt iti tarkamūlasāmānyavyāptyāderāśraṇīyatayā pūrvoktamevāpratiṣṭhitatvaṃ punarāpadyetetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: anirmokṣa prasaṅkāt ṅgaḥ aprayojaka tva parihāka artham tad vilakṣaṇa tvam brahma avilakṣaṇa tvam vā tad upādānaka tve brahma upādānaka tve vā na syāt iti tarka mūla sāmānya vyāpti ādeḥ āśraṇīya tayā pūrva uktam eva apratiṣṭhita tvam punar āpadyeta iti arthaḥ

original: yadvā vilakṣaṇatvaheturnāprayojake nirvikāratvabodhakaśrutyanukūlatvāt iityasyānumānasya svarūpāsiddhyadināpratiṣṭhitatvādanirmokṣa iti yojanā|

original: yattu -- caśabdabhāvānnāsya hetvantaratvaṃ yuktam| kiṃ ca anyathānumeyam| ityanena tvayāpyekasūtratayā svīkṛtasya tarkāpratiṣṭhānādityasya madrītyā anyathā svapakṣadoṣācca ityādisūtroktādvaiparītyenānumeyaṃ tarkāpratiṣṭhānāt ityekavākyatayā śrutasādhyātvayena śaṅkāviśeṣatve ca saṃbhavati vilakṣaṇayorapi kāryakāraṇabhāvasya na hāniḥ|
analyzed: yat tu caśabda bhāvāt na asya hetu antara tvam yuktam kim ca anyathā anumeyam iti anena tvayā api eka sūtratayā svīkṛtasya tarka apratiṣṭhānāt ityasya mad rītyā anyathā sva pakṣa doṣāt ca ityādi sūtra uktāt vaiparītyena anumeyam tarka apratiṣṭhānāt iti eka vākyatayā śruta sādhya ātvayena śaṅkā viśeṣa tve ca saṃbhavati vilakṣaṇayoḥ api kārya kāraṇa bhāvasya na hāniḥ

original: tarkasyāpratiṣṭhitatvāt ityevamadhyāhṛtasādhyānvayena vākyaṃ bhittvā siddhāntaśeṣatvoktyayogaḥ| anirmokṣapratiyogano’nuṣaṅgāpattiśca| prasaṅgaśabdavaiyarthya ceti candrikāyā dūṣaṇamuktam| tadasat| ca śabdābhāve’pi tatsamānārthakāpiśabdasattvena hetvantaratvopapatteḥ|

original: yadyapi hetvantaraparatve tatpratipādakabhāgasya mūtrāntaratvāmucitaṃ tathāpi tarkāpratiṣṭānāt ityaṃśasyānirmokṣapratiyogisamarpakatayottaravākyaikavākyatāpyastīti sūcanāya mūtraikyānusaraṇam| īkṣaternāśabdam gauṇaścennātmaśabdāt | ānandamayo’bhyāsāt vikāraśabdānneti cenna prācuryāt

original: jñeyatvāvacanācca vadatīti cenna prājño hi prakaraṇāt ityādau tu īkṣaṇābhyāsajñeyatvāderuttaravākyārthe’praviṣṭatayā pṛthakasūtratvamādṛtam| anyathāśabdokaktānyatvapratiyogitayātyantāvyavahitatarkāpratiṣṭhānasyānvayasaṃbhave pūrvasūtroktāditipadādhyāhāreṇa vyavahitasya tatpratiyogitvonānnavayopagamasya jaghanyatvācca|
analyzed: jñeya tva avacanāt ca vadati iti ced na prājñaḥ hi prakaraṇāt ityādau tu īkṣaṇa abhyāsa jñeya tva ādeḥ uttara vākya arthe praviṣṭatayā pṛthaka sūtra tvam ādṛtam anyathā śabda ukakta anyatva pratiyogitayā atyanta avyavahita tarka apratiṣṭhānasya anvaya saṃbhave pūrva sūtra uktāt iti pada adhyāhāreṇa vyavahitasya tad pratiyogitva ūna anna vaya upagamasya jaghanya tvāt ca

original: kiṃ ca tarkasāmānyasyānukūlatarkaśūnyatayābhāsatvarūpam| pratiṣṭhitatvaṃ nānyathānumeyatvarūpasādhyasādhakam| svasyāpi tarkasāmānyantargatatayā bhāsatvāt| anyathā ca siddhāntyabhimatatarkasyābhāsatvāsiddhyānyathānumityayogāditi tarkāpratiṣṭhānādanyathānumeyam| iti vyāhatānumānaparatayā tavaiva vyākhyānamanucitam|
analyzed: kim ca tarka sāmānyasya anukūla tarka śūnyatayā ābhāsa tva rūpam pratiṣṭhita tvam na anyathā anumeya tva rūpa sādhya sādhakam svasya api tarka sāmāni antargata tayā bhāsa tvāt anyathā ca siddhānti abhimata tarkasya ābhāsa tva asiddhyā anyathā anumiti ayogāt iti tarka apratiṣṭhānāt anyathā anumeyam iti vyāhata anumāna para tayā tava eva vyākhyānam anucitam

original: mama cu śrutipratyakṣānyatarasāhāyyarahitastarka eva tarkaśabdena gṛhyata iti na doṣaḥ| siddhāntasādhakahetvantaratvaparatve saṃbhavati nirasanīyaśaṅkāśeṣatvakalpanāyā evānucitatvācca|
analyzed: mama cu śruti pratyakṣa anyatara sāhāyya rahitaḥ tarkaḥ eva tarka śabdena gṛhyate iti na doṣaḥ siddhānta sādhaka hetu antara tva paratve saṃbhavati nirasanīya śaṅkā śeṣa tva kalpanāyāḥ eva anucita tvāt ca

original: ūktarītyā vyāhatyākrāntahetuparatāya vyākhyānamapekṣya sādhyāntarānvayaṃ vākyabhedamanirmokṣapratiyogino’nuṣaṅgaṃ ca svīkṛtya sūtrayojanamevocitamiti spaṣṭamevaviduṣām| prathamayadvetyādirītyā dvitīyadvetyādirītyā ca sūtrayojanāyāṃ manmate vyāhatiśaṅkāyā evāprasaraḥ|
analyzed: ūkta rītyā vyāhati ākrānta hetu paratāya vyākhyānam apekṣya sādhya antara anvayam vākyabhedam anirmokṣa pratiyoginaḥ anuṣaṅgam ca svīkṛtya sūtra yojanam eva ucitam iti spaṣṭam eva viduṣām prathama yat vā ityādi rītyā dvitīya dvā ityādi rītyā ca sūtra yojanāyām mad mate vyāhati śaṅkāyāḥ eva aprasaraḥ

original: arnirmokṣaprasaṅgādityasya muktyabhāvaprasaṅgādityarthapakṣe prasaṅgapadasārthakyamatispaṣṭameva|

original: yadapi candrikāyām -- kiṃ tarkamātrasyāpratiṣṭhitatvaṃ kivāṃ śrityādyananugrahītasya | nādyaḥ| tarkāpratiṣṭhicatvasādhakatarkasyā pyapratiṣṭhitatvena tarkāpratiṣṭhānāsiddheḥ| mīmāsānārambhaprasaṅgaśca mantavyaśca| so’nveṣṭavyaḥ yastarkeṇānusaṃdhatte ityādiśrutismṛtiviradhācca na dvitīyaḥ|
analyzed: yat api candrikāyām kim tarka mātrasya apratiṣṭhita tvam śriti ādi ananugrahītasya na ādyaḥ tarka apratiṣṭhicatva sādhaka tarkasya api apratiṣṭhita tvena tarka apratiṣṭhāna asiddheḥ mīmāsāna ārambha prasaṅgaḥ ca mantavyaḥ ca saḥ unveṣṭavyaḥ yaḥ tarkeṇa anusaṃdhatte ityādi śruti smṛti viradhāt ca na dvitīyaḥ

original: brahmaṇo’nupādānatvasādhakasya vailakṣaṇyarūpatarkasya nirvikāram iti śrutyanugṛhītatvāditi dūṣaṇamuktam| tadatiśithilam| uktarītyā śrutyādyananugṛhītasyaiva tarkasya kevalena tarkeṇa iti bhāṣyeṇāpratiṣṭhitatvoktervikalpasya svabuddhimātrakalpitatvāt|
analyzed: brahmaṇaḥ anupādānatva sādhakasya vailakṣaṇya rūpa tarkasya nirvikāram iti śruti anugṛhīta tvāt iti dūṣaṇam uktam tat ati śithilam ukta rītyā śruti ādi ananugṛhītasya eva tarkasya kevalena tarkeṇa iti bhāṣyeṇa apratiṣṭhita tva ukteḥ vikalpasya sva buddhi mātra kalpita tvāt

original: satyabhāvatvaparyavasitaṃ pratiṣedhamātratvamasiddhamiti hetusvarūpāvivecanāyāṃ tvaduktarītyā prāgabhāvasya sadbhinnatvāsaṃbhavena kathacitsaṃbhave ta tadrītyaiva tasya pratiṣedhamātratvasyāpi saṃbhavena svarūpāsiddhyabhāvāttannirākāraṇāyābhāvadharmātmatāmantareṇetyādihetusvarūpanirvacanaprayāsavaiphalyena cāsacchabdasya

original: utpattyanantaraṃ prāgabhāvasyāsattvenotpatteḥ pūrva ghaṭasyaivāsattvenāsatā ghaṭena prāgabhāvena vā saṃbandhānirūpaṇātprāgabhāvasya ghaṭīyatvā siddheḥ| pratiyogyanuyogibhāva eva saṃbandha ityapi na | tasya svarūpasaṃbandhaviśeṣarūpatvena pratyekasvarūpatvena saṃyogādivatsaṃbandhatvāsaṃpratipatteḥ| pratītimātrasya vastvāsādhakatvāt|

original: tādṛśapratīteḥ prāgabhāvaviṣayakatvameva nātyantābhāvaviṣayakatvamiti vaktu śakyam| utpatteḥ pūrvamasattvāviśeṣa uktaviśeṣasyāsiddheḥ| tanmate śaśaviṣāṇotpatterāpādanīyatvāt| utpanno’pi ghaṭaḥ punarutpadyeta pākajarūparasādīnāṃ bhedaśca na syādyadi prāgabhāvasya na hetutvam|

original: prāgabhāvādanyasya kāraṇasya tatrābhedāt iti pūrvapakṣe candrikoktaṃ na tu sat| ghaṭaṃ prati ghaṭasya pratibandhakatvena klṛptatadatyantābhāvasya kāraṇatvakalpanayaivotpannaghaṭotpatterāpādanāyogāt| ghaṭotpatteḥ pūrvamatyantābhāvasattvamupapāditameva | ekā sāmagryekameva kāryaṃ janayatīti svabhāvakalpanāt|

original: na vā prāgabhāvadanyasya kāraṇasthābhedātpākajarūparasādīnāmabhedāpāttiḥ| vijātīyarūpasatvādyavacchinnaṃ pratyekajātīyāgrisaṃyogarūpapākasya hetutvamiti kāryakāraṇabhāvānurodheneva tadbhedasiddheḥ| tadvirodhena pratyakṣavirodhena ca tadaikyāpādanasyāsaṃbhavāt|
